description: Security group ingress on 30000-32767/tcp (the Kubernetes NodePort range) from 0.0.0.0/0
note: Neither tool covers an arbitrary port range open to the world: checkov's public-ingress rules are per well-known port, and Trivy's AWS-0107 is SSH/RDP only. IACP-0001 (lambda/terraform-scanner/checks/) is this project's check for it; tfsec used to catch it, and this was one of the two PugetScope findings that motivated context-agent. Was labelled empty from 2026-09-13 until the check landed the same day.
